evaluator: Blind Stagebench evaluator: measured the published build/ served at 127.0.0.1:5433 (served bundle index-HT5pAiRy.js / index-CE46N1y3.css matches build/assets) in Playwright Chromium at 1440x900 and 390x844, with an AnalyserNode spliced in front of the app's own AudioContext destination for real signal measurement.
summary: An unusually complete Stage 4 system. All three engines are genuinely separate: piano from bundled recorded sets, organ from additive tonewheel banks (spectral centroid 211 Hz on B3 vs 1918 Hz Farf, 2350 Hz Pipe 2), synth from five oscillator recipes with category-correct Osc Ctrl (Pure delta 0 Hz, FM-H delta +801 Hz). One AudioContext, six per-layer chains, every effect unit and type measurably alters rendered audio, and morphs, splits, scenes, transpose, panic, 32+8 program slots and Live Mode all round-trip and reach the signal. 231/231 controls are pointer-reachable at 1440x900, all 73 keys sit inside the keybed, the five reference colours match within deltaE 7.5, and deck/keybed/width/aspect land on target (0.5400 / 0.4600 / 0.9400 / 3.0951). The one structural miss is horizontal: the six section widths are hardcoded to the superseded 13/21/15/9/21/21 ratios (src/model/variant.ts:35-40), so Piano is 0.146 against a specified 0.085 and Program 0.087 against 0.125 - visible as a cramped, overlapping Program column. Narrow viewport is a plain downscale, recognizable but not operable.

criteria.label: Distinct engine character
evidence: Analyser tap on the app's AudioContext destination, E3/G3/B3 chord: spectral centroid piano-Grand 793 Hz, piano-Upright 1010 Hz, piano-Electric 385 Hz, organ-B3 211 Hz, organ-Farf 1918 Hz, organ-Pipe2 2350 Hz, synth-Pure 1088 Hz, synth-Super 1479 Hz. Cross-engine log-spectrum cosine similarity 0.29-0.56 (organ vs synth) versus 0.93-0.97 within the drawbar organ family.

All six organ models reached from the panel Model button (B3, B3 Bass, Vox, Farf, Pipe 1, Pipe 2) and all five synth categories from Waveform Select (Pure, Sync, Multi, Super, FM-H), each producing audio with a different harmonic set - e.g. Vox carries partials at 328/387/492 Hz that B3 lacks at the same 8-8-8 registration.

Osc Ctrl behaves per category exactly as specs/nord-stage-4.synth.json oscCtrlByCategory requires: sweeping 0->127 moved centroid by 0 Hz on Pure ('no effect'), +545 Hz Sync, +460 Hz Multi, +733 Hz Super, +801 Hz FM-H.

criteria.label: Effects & routing integration
evidence: Instrumented AudioContext constructor counted exactly 1 context for the whole session; state exposes six chains (A, B, organ, synthA, synthB, synthC) and FX Focus auto-followed to {section:'organ',layer:'A'} when the organ layer was enabled.

Organ layer through the shared chain: Reverb off tail RMS after note-off 0.000 -> Reverb on 0.008; Mod 1 on at amount 127 gave 21.1% amplitude-modulation depth against a 4.0% baseline; Rotary (organ To Rotary) produced 0.256 modulation depth slow and 0.270 fast.

Every unit type altered the rendered signal on the piano chain: Mod 1 Tremolo/Ring Mod/A-Wah/Wah/Pump/A-Pan centroids 768-967 Hz, Mod 2 Chorus/Ensemble/Spin/Phaser/Flanger/Vibe 878-1121 Hz, Amp Neutral/Twin/JC/Small 1029-1391 Hz, Delay changed envelope depth 0.966 -> 0.741, Comp changed RMS 0.017 -> 0.065. All FX Off toggled cleanly.

criteria.label: Musical quality under load
evidence: 40-note cluster (MIDI 36-75) held simultaneously: peak 0.415, RMS 0.082, no clipping and no console errors. Worst case tried - Amp Sim drive at maximum plus 30 notes at velocity 120 - peaked at 0.967, still below full scale, so the master limiter holds.

Note-on to first audible sample measured in-page at 28.8 ms with ctx.baseLatency 5.3 ms / outputLatency 32 ms; three engines sounding at once across split zones stayed stable and Panic took RMS 0.183 -> 0.000 within 400 ms.
No 'error' or 'pageerror' console output was captured across nine scripted interaction passes over the served build.

criteria.label: Program & state round-trip
evidence: Edited piano type Grand->Upright, drawbar 5 to value 6 and Organ Layer A on, pressed Store twice (confirm prompt 'Store to 1.1? STORE confirms, Shift cancels'), navigated to program 3 (Gospel B3, type Grand, drawbar 0) and back to program 1: recalled {type:'Upright', db5:6, organA:true} matched the stored state exactly.

Dirty flag is truthful: the Program OLED first line read '1.1' before editing, '1.1 E' after any edit, and reverted to '1.1' immediately after Store; a post-store edit re-raised the E and re-selecting slot 1.1 restored the stored value.

State exposes 32 program slots plus 8 Live slots; in Live Mode a piano-type edit survived a program-2/program-1 round trip without an explicit store (auto-store), and an Undo entry is offered on the OLED.

criteria.label: Performance controls & bindings
evidence: Morph assign works end to end: holding Morph Wheel and driving Piano Layer A level to 0 recorded {kind:'layerLevel', layer:'pianoA', from:100, to:0}; wheel at 0 gave RMS 0.0436 and wheel at 1 gave RMS 0.000, and the on-screen wheel's aria-valuenow tracked the morph value (0 -> 95 when the source was set to 0.75).
Pitch stick drag with a real mouse moved aria-valuenow 0 -> 67 and bent the sounding C4 from 527.3 Hz to 562.5 Hz, then sprang back to 0 and 527.3 Hz on release.

Web MIDI through an injected MIDIAccess: status strip read 'MIDI connected: Fake MIDI', 0x90 note-on produced RMS 0.029, CC1=127 drove morphValues.wheel to 1 (widget aria-valuenow 127) and CC11=100 drove morphValues.pedal to 0.787. Computer keyboard 'a' sounded at RMS 0.021; with Space held the note was still audible at 0.0012 after key release where the unsustained control note had already fallen to exactly 0.000, and it stopped on Space release.

criteria.label: Cross-system workflows
evidence: Split on, zones set to pianoA 0-0 / organA 1-1 / synthA 2-3 with all three sections enabled: notes 36, 52, 64 and 84 returned centroids 672, 697, 795 and 1592 Hz, i.e. different engines answering different regions of the same keybed. Split state carries three points (low/mid/high) with position and xfade, and the split LED strip above the keybed lit at the active point.
Transpose: with Transpose on and +5 semitones, C4 shifted from a 527 Hz dominant partial (2nd harmonic of 261.6 Hz) to a 351.6 Hz fundamental - F4 is 349.2 Hz.

Panic with 8 notes spread across piano, organ and synth zones took RMS 0.183 -> 0.000 (peak 0.621 before). Layer Scenes I/II store independent per-layer enable maps for all seven layers and switch between them from the panel.

criteria.label: Organ system
evidence: Nine drawbars are live: pulling all nine out moved the rendered centroid from 196 Hz to 676 Hz; the drawbar LED ladders track the value. Six models selectable from the panel Model button.

Percussion On raised the early attack envelope from [0, 0.0072, 0.0305, 0.0428, 0.0529] to [0, 0.0181, 0.0703, 0.0881, 0.1065]; Vib/Chorus On raised sustained-tone modulation depth from 0.048 to 0.200 at mode C3.

Rotary integration verified through the organ To Rotary route: 0.256 modulation depth at slow, 0.270 at fast, and the single Rotary Speaker instance sits on the Performance band as the reference photo shows.

criteria.label: Synth system
evidence: Filters: Filter Freq 20 -> 127 swept centroid 205 Hz -> 2800 Hz, and the four required types measured distinctly at freq 70 (LP12 699 Hz, LP24 557 Hz, HP 3657 Hz, BP 1619 Hz).

Envelopes and LFO: amp attack 0 gave first-frames [0, 0.0062, 0.0149, 0.0200] against [0, 0.00001, 0.00006, 0.00013] at attack 110; LFO -> Filter Freq widened the per-frame centroid range from [1073,1749] to [503,1851] and LFO -> Osc Pitch to [1246,2061]. Three destinations (Osc Pitch, Osc Ctrl, Filter Freq) and five waves (TRI/SAW down/SAW up/SQ/S&H) are on the panel.

Voice and arp: unison 3 moved centroid 1118 -> 1321 Hz; Mono with glide 60 left G4 (measured 386.7 Hz) as the only sounding voice with C4+G4 held; Arp Run gated a held C-E-G triad into 14 threshold crossings over 2.5 s. Pure category exposes 7 waveforms ('PURE CAT 2/7 WAVE' on the synth OLED), matching the spec's required Pure list. Samples/Extern are truthfully declared unimplemented and their selector is inert (optional / excluded in the spec).

criteria.label: Layers, splits, scenes & morphs
evidence: Seven layers exist with independent state (piano A/B, organ A/B, synth A/B/C) and seven zone entries; zones are editable per layer and split points carry an xfade field.

Layer Scenes I and II hold separate per-layer enable maps (scene I {pianoA:true, organA:true, ...} vs scene II {pianoA:true, organA:false, ...}) and the Layer Scene button switches the active scene, with the state shown on the Program OLED perf line ('Scene II').

Morph sources reach real destinations across sections: wheel->pianoA level silenced the layer at full wheel, and an organ-level assignment recorded {from:100,to:96} with an 8% audible RMS drop; the Program OLED perf line and the wheel widget both reflect the morph.

criteria.label: Programs & Live Mode
evidence: 32 program slots plus 8 Live slots in state; program page navigation moved the on-panel indicator (data-testid='program-page') from PAGE 1/4 to PAGE 3/4 after two Page presses, and the program dial stepped 1.1 'Royal Grand' -> 1.2 'Tine Stack'.
Store flow is two-stage with an explicit confirm line on the OLED and a Store As naming flow; List view, Solo/Undo, Prog View and Bank stepping are all present and operable.
Live Mode: entering it switched the OLED to 'LIVE L1 / Live Init', edits auto-stored across a slot round trip, and the status line reported 'L1 Live Init (edits discarded - Undo available)'.

criteria.label: Chassis, silhouette & geometry

measurements.label: Worst of the six section-fraction deviations

evidence: getBoundingClientRect at 1440x900, page unscrolled: instrument 43.20,204.83 1353.59x437.33; deck-block height 236.16 (236.16/437.33 = 0.5400); keys-block height 201.16 (0.4600); width 1353.59/1440 = 0.9400; aspect 1353.59/437.33 = 3.09514 against the variant's measured 3.0951. Page scrollHeight equals clientHeight (900), so the instrument is fully visible without vertical scroll.

Section widths measured in the same pass: performance 170.95, organ 276.17, piano 197.25, program 118.34, synth 276.17, effects 276.17 px. As fractions of instrument width: 0.1263 / 0.2040 / 0.1457 / 0.0874 / 0.2040 / 0.2040 against spec 0.14 / 0.20 / 0.085 / 0.125 / 0.25 / 0.20. Worst deviation 0.0607 on Piano. Using the deck content extent (54.03-1385.97) as denominator instead gives 0.0631, so the result does not hinge on the denominator choice.

criteria.label: Hardware inventory & placement

measurements.label: Required section landmarks rendered in their own section
Controls a pointer can actually operate

evidence: All 33 sectionLandmarks entries were found rendered inside their own [data-section] element at 1440x900: performance 5/5 (perf-master-level, rotary-* cluster, perf-pitch-stick, perf-mod-wheel, 'nord stage 4 HAMMER ACTION 73' silkscreen); organ 4/4 (organ-drawbar-1..9, 9-segment led-ladder per layer, organ-model, organ-perc-on/volume/decay/harmonic); piano 5/5 (piano-level-a/b, piano-type, piano-model, piano-timbre, piano-acoustics/kb-touch/dyn-comp/unison); program 7/7 (oled-program at 752,293 inside the program section, program-dial, program-1..8, page-left/right, live-mode + layer-scene, store + store-as + split-onset, morph-wheel/at/ctrlped); synth 6/6 (oled-synth at 924,243, synth-level-a/b/c, waveform-select/osc-ctrl/osc-pitch-smp, filter-*, osc/filter/amp envelopes, lfo-* and arp-*); effects 6/6 (mod1-*, mod2-*, amp-*/eq-*, delay-*, comp-*, reverb-*, fx-focus-piano/synth with organ A/B and synth A/B/C focus LEDs).

Reachability by the rubric's method - 5x5 document.elementFromPoint grid over each bounding box at 1440x900 with the page unscrolled, no framework click helper: 231 of 231 outermost controls resolved to themselves or a descendant on at least one probe (158 panel controls plus 73 keys). No control had a minimum dimension under 8 px. The only elements extending past their section box do so by under 2 px and are not clipped.

Forbidden inventory: no OLED or full dark plate in Performance (the section carries class 'exposed-red'; only the Rotary sub-block is plated - reported as an issue), no display or drawbar bank in Organ or Piano, exactly two primary OLEDs in the whole build (Program and Synth), no wide display spanning the Synth section, no undifferentiated grid in Layer Effects. Count 0.

criteria.label: Keybed fidelity

measurements.label: Keys whose box falls inside the keybed

evidence: Keybed box 61.47,440.98 1317.06x188.09. All 73 [data-midi] elements have boxes fully inside it (left/right/top/bottom within 0.5 px), so keysInsideKeybed = 73/73. MIDI range 28-100 with aria-labels E1..E7, matching the Stage 4 73 variant's 'E to E'.

43 elements carry the white-key class and 30 the black-key class. White keys are uniformly 30.63x188.09 px (one distinct height), black keys 17.45x114.73 px (one distinct height): black-key height fraction 114.73/188.09 = 0.6100 against the variant target 0.61, black-key width fraction 0.570.

criteria.label: Chassis & plate colour fidelity
evidence: Screenshot of the instrument element (1354x439) colour-histogrammed; surfaces covering at least 0.02% of instrument pixels compared to specs referenceColors in CIE76 deltaE: chassisMid #851a25 -> #811f2a dE 4.51, chassisDark #5a0c13 -> #631b24 dE 7.44, panelBlueGray #3c424d -> #3c424d dE 0.00, keyBlack #0b0b0b -> #0b0b0b dE 0.00, keyWhite #dcdcdc -> #dcdcdc dE 0.00. All 5 within the dE 12 threshold.

Result is stable under stricter area thresholds: at a 0.5%-of-instrument floor (24 surviving surface colours) the worst match is still chassisMid at dE 9.96 and chassisDark at dE 9.74, so no match depends on a hairline gradient stop.

criteria.label: Materials, legends & displays
evidence: Materials are convincingly modelled at 3x zoom: shaded knob caps with index lines, fader caps on tracks, drawbars with hardware-correct cap colouring (brown 16'/5-1/3', white and black above), 9-segment LED ladders beside every level fader and drawbar, and OLEDs rendered as green-on-black multi-line panels carrying live text ('1.1 / Royal Grand / 120 - Transp off - Split off - Scene I'). Footage legends read 16', 5-1/3', 8', 4', 2-2/3', 2', 1-3/5', 1-1/3', 1' in the correct order.

Legibility is the weak point: 246 legend elements render at computed font sizes of 3.25-9.75 px (most at 4.06-5.41 px), 11 legends overflow and are ellipsised ('RATE/TIME', 'TRI - SAW - SAW - SQ - S&H', 'ROOM - STAGE - BOOTH - HALL - SPRING...'), the Program column's 'MORPH ASSIGN' header is clipped at the top edge and 'PROGRAM' overprints 'NUM PAD', and the Reverb block's bottom legend is cut off by the section boundary. The reference photograph shows no truncation or overprinting anywhere on the deck.

criteria.label: Panel state & displays
evidence: Control positions track parameters exactly. Piano Layer B fader: Home gave aria-valuenow 0 with cap style 'calc(100% - 1 * var(--fader-cap-h))' and store level 0; End gave aria-valuenow 127, cap at 0% and all 9 ladder LEDs lit. The mod wheel's aria-valuenow moved 0 -> 95 when the wheel morph source was set to 0.75 programmatically, i.e. the widget follows canonical state rather than only local input.

Layer state read from data attributes rather than LED colour: enabling Piano Layer B flipped its button to aria-pressed='true' data-lit='true' while the store showed layers.B.enabled true and focusedLayer 'B'. FX Focus followed automatically to {section:'organ',layer:'A'} when the organ layer was enabled.

Displays read live values: the Program OLED status line reported 'Organ A On', 'Stored 1.1 Royal Grand', 'Filter Freq 617 Hz' and 'Transpose On (0)' as those edits were made; the perf line tracked '120 - Transp 0 - Split C4 - Scene II'; the edited flag rendered as '1.1 E' and cleared on Store; the page indicator read PAGE 1/4 -> PAGE 3/4; the split LED strip above the keybed lit at the active split point. Only gap found: the Synth OLED does not follow non-oscillator edits (logged as an issue).

criteria.label: Narrow-viewport retention
evidence: At 390x844 the whole instrument is preserved as a uniform downscale: instrument box 378x122 CSS px, all six sections and all 73 keys still rendered, document scrollWidth 390 (no horizontal scroll), nothing clipped, and 228 of 231 controls still resolve under the 5x5 elementFromPoint probe.

It is not usable at that size: 186 of 231 controls have a minimum dimension below 8 px (median 3.6 px, 10th percentile 2.3 px, largest 9.5 px), white keys are roughly 5 px wide, and every deck legend is sub-pixel illegible. The layout also leaves about 300 px of empty background above the instrument rather than using the height.

issues.title: Six section widths hardcoded to superseded spec fractions
issues.detail: src/model/variant.ts:35-40 sets fractions 0.13/0.21/0.15/0.09/0.21/0.21. specs/nord-stage-4.visual.json v1.3.0 specifies 0.14/0.20/0.085/0.125/0.25/0.20 (photo-measured, corrected 2026-07-04). Measured on the rendered page at 1440x900 against an instrument width of 1353.6 px: Piano 0.1457 (dev 0.0607), Synth 0.2040 (dev 0.0460), Program 0.0874 (dev 0.0376), Performance 0.1263 (dev 0.0137). Section boundaries read off the reference photograph (deck resampled to 1800 px) agree with the spec, not with the build: Piano occupies about 0.067 and Program about 0.139 of the deck there. Worst deviation is 5x the 0.012 tolerance.

issues.title: Narrow viewport is a uniform downscale with no responsive adaptation
issues.detail: At 390x844 the instrument renders 378x122 CSS px. Nothing clips and there is no horizontal scroll, but 186 of 231 controls have a minimum dimension under 8 px (median 3.6 px, 10th percentile 2.3 px, largest 9.5 px) and every silkscreen legend is illegible. The instrument also sits at y=299 with roughly 300 px of empty background above it.

issues.title: Rotary Speaker block rendered on a dark inset plate instead of exposed red chassis
issues.detail: specs/nord-stage-4.visual.json sectionLandmarks.performance declares surface 'exposed red chassis' and reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg shows the Rotary Speaker controls silkscreened directly on the red chassis with only a thin outline. The build wraps them in a blue-gray plate about 32% of the Performance section width. The landmark is still rendered in its own section so it is counted present, and it is not the 'full dark inset plate' the forbidden list targets, but it contradicts the photograph. The plate also overlaps the 'CTRL PEDAL' legend, which is cut mid-word.

issues.title: Truncated and overlapping panel legends
issues.detail: 11 legends overflow their box and are cut with an ellipsis at 1440x900 (measured via scrollWidth > clientWidth): 'RATE/TIME', 'ARP - POLY - GATE', 'UP - DOWN - U/D - RND', 'TRI - SAW - SAW - SQ - S&H', 'OSC PITCH - OSC CTRL - FILTER', 'ENV TO CTRL - VEL OFF', 'TRACK 1/3 - DRIVE OFF', 'ROOM - STAGE - BOOTH - HALL - SPRING...' among others. In the over-narrow Program column the 'MORPH ASSIGN' header is clipped at the top edge and 'PROGRAM' overprints 'NUM PAD'; in Layer Effects the Reverb block's bottom ON/GLOBAL legend is cut by the section edge. Legend font sizes run 3.25-5.95 px.

issues.title: Candidate evidence misattributes its section ratios to the spec
issues.detail: artifact/tests/feature-matrix.json (visual.section-layout) and evidence/stage3-visual-audit.md both state 'Six ordered sections at 13/21/15/9/21/21% widths ... per nord-stage-4.visual.json'. The shipped spec v1.3.0 says otherwise, so the audit's drift check validated the wrong target.

issues.title: Clav, Digital and Misc piano types have no bundled model
issues.detail: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares that selecting these three of the six piano types flashes the LED, reports 'Piano not found' and plays nothing rather than substituting a voice. The declaration is honest and matches the spec's missingModelState, but three of the six required piano types remain silent in the final artifact.

issues.title: Synth OLED does not follow non-oscillator edits
issues.detail: Driving Filter Freq updated the Program OLED status line to 'Filter Freq 617 Hz' but the Synth OLED kept showing 'OSC WAVEFORM / Saw / OSC CTRL 5.0 / ANALOG TYPE'. On the hardware the synth display follows the parameter being edited.
